assessment: Congratulations on this useful and technically impressive paper demonstrating that phylogenetic and epidemiologic data can be used in a retrospective cohort to reconstruct that chain of events in terms of case importation into a high risk geriatrics ward. The conclusion that HCW (healthcare worker) transmission in non-COVID wards was particularly important is critical for hospital epidemiologists. The methodology advances will hopefully push the field forward in terms of tracking outbreaks in various settings.
